outside_sources.title: glTF-Blender-IO — Khronos Group official Blender glTF plugin
outside_sources.author: Khronos Group

technique_notes: bpy.data.collections iteration with startswith(EXPORT_PREFIX) — prefix convention avoids exporting utility/helper collections
LayerCollection vs Collection distinction — view_layer.active_layer_collection requires LayerCollection, not Collection
find_layer_collection() recursive traversal maps Collection → LayerCollection for the active view layer
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(use_active_collection=True) scopes export to the active LayerCollection without touching selection state
export_apply=True bakes modifiers + transforms at export time without mutating source data in .blend
export_yup=True enforces +Y-up convention (glTF spec); Blender is +Z-up so the exporter applies a -90° X rotation at the root
Draco quantisation: position=14 bits (near-lossless), normals=10 bits, UVs=12 bits — lower bits = smaller file but visible error
snake_case() renames root objects before export so glTF node names are clean identifiers (no spaces, dots, or capitals)
manifest JSON written after all exports: blender_version, draco_level, per-export slug/path/polygon/size_kb
os.makedirs(exist_ok=True) — idempotent; safe to re-run the script without manual directory cleanup
